title: Proportional-Fair Resource Allocation and Dual-Threshold Early-Exit Inference for Secure Cooperative Multi-Layer Edge Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2609.15847v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes FREDI (Fair Resource Allocation for Edge Dual-Threshold Inference), a secure wireless edge-intelligence framework for event-triggered inference in a cooperative user equipment (UE)--edge server (ES)--cloud system. Each UE performs early-exit convolutional neural network (CNN) screening using dual confidence thresholds, while critical events are securely offloaded to an edge server for detailed classification. We formulate a proportionally-fair utility maximization problem that jointly optimizes UE--ES association, wireless and processing resources, and confidence thresholds. FREDI decomposes the problem into proportional-fair resource allocation and dual-threshold inference optimization. We prove that the detected-critical event set is set-monotone non-increasing in both thresholds, and exploit the finite empirical confidence domain for exact threshold optimization. translated_title: 面向安全协同多层边缘智能的比例公平资源分配与双阈值早退推理
translated_abstract: 本文提出了FREDI（面向边缘双阈值推理的公平资源分配），这是一个用于协同用户设备（UE）—边缘服务器（ES）—云系统中事件触发推理的安全无线边缘智能框架。每个用户设备使用双置信度阈值执行早退卷积神经网络（CNN）筛选，而关键事件则被安全地卸载到边缘服务器进行详细分类。我们构建了一个比例公平效用最大化问题，联合优化UE—ES关联、无线与处理资源以及置信度阈值。FREDI将该问题分解为比例公平资源分配和双阈值推理优化两个子问题。我们证明了检测到的关键事件集合相对于两个阈值均具有集合单调不增性，并利用有限的经验置信度域实现精确的阈值优化。经验性的资源—效用响应包络…
tldr: 本文提出FREDI安全边缘智能框架，将双置信度阈值早退推理与比例公平资源分配进行联合优化，实现了用户设备—边缘服务器—云协同系统中事件触发推理的高效安全处理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FREDI, a secure edge-intelligence framework that jointly optimizes dual-threshold early-exit inference and proportional-fair resource allocation for efficient and secure event-triggered classification in cooperative UE–edge-server–cloud systems.
